version: Tononi-v3 common scalp montage, before label-dependent modeling
method: Intersection of numbered EEG channels available in every non-excluded EDF; keep SFP z >= 5, exclude the participant-1 flat channel 81, choose 16 positions by deterministic farthest-point sampling beginning at the highest z coordinate. No dream-report labels were used.
qc: Selected channels were checked in the first 30 seconds of all 282 compatible EDFs. The fixed peak/flat rule flags 38 windows; timing and later-window validity remain separate questions.
